GraphX

Road-junction network for this selection

Roads are vertices and junctions where accidents happened are edges. The graph is rebuilt for every filter change, then PageRank (10 iterations, reset 0.15) and connected components run on it, the same algorithms the live dashboard runs on Spark GraphX.

Larger circle = higher PageRank; the five most central roads are red. Hover a road to see its links.

Most dangerous junctions

MLlib

Prediction models compared

Three models trained by Spark MLlib on the same 80% of the accidents and the same features (including the GraphX features): Logistic Regression, a Random Forest (60 trees, depth 8) and a Decision Tree Regressor (depth 8). Their weights and trees were exported from Spark, so this page gives the same scores as the live models. Pick the conditions of an accident to compare their predictions.
